wpa_lists.what: The rows this job reads from the wpa-lists job's output, copied unchanged (same header, same bytes per row): every NUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv row dated 1850-1913 or citing this book ('IR 22'), and every UNNUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv (Lord's list) row citing this book ('I IR 24') in its summary or citation_text. With these rows the job's outputs are the same as with the full files. Used unless WPA_DIR names another folder.

derived_from.outputs: the job's output folder from that commit, run locally (scratchpad wpa_out)
